title: Voice Actor Kentarō Itō Goes on Hiatus Following Brain Hemorrhage, Surgery
content: The agency stated that a few days ago Itō suddenly started feeling unwell, and was transported to the hospital, where he had symptoms of a brain hemorrhage, and underwent emergency surgery that same day. Mausu Promotion said his life is not in danger, and his postoperative progress is going well.
author: ANN

title: Aizen Is Back in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 48 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 8 (Episode 48 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Part 2 Trailer and October 13 Premiere Revealed, Sora Amamiya Joins Cast
content: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle revealed a new trailer for its Cour 2, along with the theme songs and an October 13, 2026 premiere. Sora Amamiya is joining the cast as Mai Todo. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge Browser Game Launches on September 14
content: The game is free-to-play with in-app purchases, and will be available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. Viz Media describes the light novel series' story: Invaders from the Crimson Realm have come to Earth looking for something called the Power of Existence.
author: ANN

title: 'Toaru Anbu no Item' Announces Additional Staff
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item ( A Certain Dark Side's Item ) light novel revealed additional staff and a key visual (pictured) on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 9 at 10.30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Cast and September 26 Streaming Premiere
content: A Wild Last Boss Appeared has revealed its second Season 2 trailer, confirming that the anime will have a streaming premiere on September 26 a week ahead of its regular TV broadcast starting in October 2026. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Torch TV Anime Reveals 'Final' Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Tsuyoshi Takaki 's Black Torch manga revealed a "final" promotional video for the anime on Friday, previewing both the 11th and 12th episodes and the "final battle." Kei Umabiki ( ClassicaLoid , Quality Assurance in Another World ) is directing the anime at 100Studio .
author: ANN

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Anime's 2nd Part Reveals October 13 Debut in Promo Video
content: Kadokawa revealed on Friday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the television anime of Hiromu and raemz 's Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle ( Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka ) light novel series will debut on October 13. The staff also revealed the theme song information and a new promotional video.
author: ANN

title: 'Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ( A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ) light novel unveiled additional cast, the ending theme, and second promotional video for the second season on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BLACK TORCH Prepares For Final Episodes With New Trailer
content: BLACK TORCH released a new “FINAL PV” trailer ahead of its concluding episodes, featuring footage from Episodes 11 and 12. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018. The anime is streaming on Crunchyroll.
author: Anime Corner
